headlines.title: S&P 500 hits record high as Nvidia nears $6 trillion milestone
headlines.description: The S&P 500 hit a record high, supported by rising technology stocks, declining oil prices and hopes for a positive earnings season.

headlines.title: Consumers sue Starbucks over ‘sugar-free’ drinks containing up to 21g of sugar
headlines.description: A consumer lawsuit is accusing Starbucks of adding sugar, sometimes as much as that in a Kit Kat bar, to drinks marketed as sugar free.

headlines.title: Political polarization is spiking in local communities ahead of the midterms, survey finds
headlines.description: Cost-of-living issues are driving up tensions in local communities, while immigration is the most polarizing issue nationally, local government officials said in a new survey.

headlines.title: Paramount Skydance completes $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros.
headlines.description: Paramount Skydance completed its $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros., creating a Hollywood heavyweight called Skydance and handing CEO David ‌Ellison control. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports on the details of the merger.

headlines.title: How to Protect Your Online Identity and Clean Your Digital Footprint
headlines.description: Whether you’re hunting for a job or looking for a relationship, first impressions matter and there are ways to control what information about you is out there. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with tips to protect your online profile, correct inaccuracies, remove unwanted data and craft a productive digital presence.

headlines.title: Ford CEO says it's his company's responsibility to bring more affordable vehicles to the U.S.
headlines.description: Americans are still buying cars, but they're borrowing record amounts of money and taking on longer car loans to help make ends meet. NBC News' Christine Romans spoke with Ford CEO Jim Farley, who said his company has five more-affordable vehicles on the way.

headlines.title: Major Retailers Kick off Early Holiday Sales: Deals to Lookout for
headlines.description: Amazon, Target, Walmart and more retailers are kicking off a major sales week for anyone trying to get a head start on holiday shopping. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to break down the early deals on apparel, Halloween costumes, tech and fuel.

headlines.title: For the same ticket on StubHub, different prices for different people
headlines.description: NBC News volunteers saw eight different prices for the exact same Harry Styles ticket on StubHub. The company said it’s running random price experiments.

headlines.title: Aiming at fuel costs, Trump opens tax-exempt ‘red dye’ diesel to all drivers
headlines.description: Trump signed an executive order intended to help bring down sky-high diesel prices by allowing anyone to purchase tax-exempt “red dye” diesel.

headlines.title: White House removes Politico from press pool for Trump’s trip to Nebraska
headlines.description: The administration took similar action last week against CNN. The cable news network, MS NOW and Politico sued after they were banned from the White House grounds.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Poll: Latino voters swing away from Trump and Republicans
headlines.description: Democrats have a significant lead among Latino voters in 2026 amid economic concerns, according to the NBC News/Telemundo poll.
